question: How does the embodied one remain unattached while acting through the body?
premises: all actions are renounced by mind
the embodied one sits happily in the nine-gated city
house-dwellers do not affect the man inside
inference: renunciation of agency leaves action without binding attachment
plain_english: Renouncing all actions by mind, the controlled embodied one sits happily in the nine-gated city, not acting or causing, just as a man inside a house is not affected by those in the house.
